title: Fold glow

reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: One ribbon folded into stacked slabs; each slab is a dark field whose color is read from the distance to its nearest edge, lit edges yellow through pink and blue, shadowed edges gray blue, all at a grain-jittered position.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 1199 × 1697 and every length scales with the canvas

slabs.does: Number of folds. The source stacks 10.

fold.does: Sideways throw of each fold: how far the left edge jumps between slabs. Measured 160 px, 0.133 of the width.

width.does: Width of the ribbon. Measured 890 px, 0.742 of the sheet.

tall.does: Share of slabs drawn 4 units high instead of 1 or 2. The source has 2 tall, 4 middle, 4 thin.

margin.does: Ground left above and below the stack. Measured 74 px at the top, 85 at the foot.

seed.does: Re-rolls the sequence of slab heights. The default draws 4 thin, 4 middle and 2 tall slabs, the source's counts, in its own order.

glowY.does: Vertical reach of the ramp from the lit edge, as a share of each slab's height. Measured on the 75, 152 and 304 px slabs: yellow and pink to 0.066 of the height, blue at 0.1, dark by 0.22.

glowTop.does: Vertical reach of the ramp from the edge that faces away from the light. Measured: dark at 0.35 to 0.4 of the height under the top edges, against 0.2 above the lit bottom edges.

glowX.does: Horizontal reach of the ramp from the slanted sides. Measured 215 px on an 890 px ribbon, whatever the skew.

rimSide.does: How far along the side ramp the yellow lasts before pink. Measured 0.23 on the slanted sides against 0.06 on the bottom edges: 52 px of yellow against 8.

topShift.does: How far along the ramp an edge facing away from the light starts, on the shadow ramp (light blue to blue to dark). Measured 0.14: the top edge's tail sits 18 px ahead of the bottom edge's.

sideShade.does: How far the slanted sides fall into the shadow ramp toward the edge that faces away from the light. Measured: the left side of the 304 px slab is gray blue for 26 px under its top, olive at 66 px, yellow from 106 px.

sideReach.does: Where the slanted side is fully lit, as a share of the slab height measured from the shadowed edge. Half shade sits at about 0.2: 16 px on the 75 px slab, 37 on the 156, 66 on the 304.

round.does: Width of the smooth minimum between the four edge distances. Small values miter the bands at the corners; the source's dark interiors have rounded corners.

curve.does: Bends the distance before it reads the ramp. Below 1 pushes the blue inward; above 1 pulls the rim colors in.

edge.does: Width of the slab outline. Measured 1 to 2 px.

grain.does: Luminance grain over the sheet. Measured 0.8 σ on the ground, 1.8 in the dark interiors.

grainSize.does: Softening of the main grain. The ground's lag-1 correlation is 0.59.

mottle.does: Share of the grain spread at 3.5 times the grain size: the slow mottle the ground's spectrum keeps below 0.05 cycles per pixel.

grainWhite.does: Share of the grain left unsoftened.

seam.does: Darkening of the first row under each fold, on the lower slab. Measured: the row under each fold reads 63 102 117 between 212 180 95 above and 67 124 177 below.

jitter.does: σ of the random offset at which each pixel reads the ramp, in px on the sides and on a 4-unit slab; thinner slabs take it in proportion to their height. It scatters blue specks into the pink band and pink into the yellow: high-pass σ 1.65 in the blue band, 2.5 in the pink, 0.6 in the flats.

phase.does: Position along the loop: the light walks once around the stack, the shadowed edge walks with it and the grain boils.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: Lit bottom edge of the tall slab: yellow for 5 px, pink by 12, blue by 36, dark by 72.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: Shadowed top edge: it starts gray blue, 65 118 180, with no yellow or pink.

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Interior: near-black green 1 37 5 with grain σ 0.7.

pass_order: ribbon: slab heights drawn from 1, 2 and 4 units, scaled to fill the sheet between the margins; the left edge jumps by the fold at every slab
ramp lookups: color against the normalized distance to an edge, through 14 measured stops for the lit edge and a gray-blue start for the shadowed one
one grain field: position-hashed noise softened 0.7 px and normalized to σ 1

per pixel: the distance to the top, the bottom and both slanted sides, each read a grain-field jitter off; the lit bottom edge through knots read off its row means, the shadowed top edge through its own knots, the sides through a stretch that holds the yellow 0.23 of the way; the sides fall into the shadow ramp toward the top, half at 0.2 of the slab's height
a smooth minimum of the four, so the corners round instead of mitering; one ramp lookup; the row under each fold darkened 0.45 for the crease; a 1.2 px anti-aliased outline
the same grain field screens every tone, with a slow mottle and a 10 % white floor

lit_edge.method: row means over x 400 to 800 up from the bottom of the 304 px slab, and R > 200 widths of 4, 10 and 23 px at the bottoms of the 75, 152 and 304 px slabs

shadow_edge.method: column profiles under the tops of the 77 and 304 px slabs

side.method: row profiles from the slanted edge at mid height of the 304 px slab

side_shade.method: olive mix fraction of the side's first 12 px at rows 545 to 700 of the 304 px slab, and the same on the 156 and 75 px slabs

crease.method: raw pixels across the fold at x 400 to 402

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Pink blue palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The stack is generated (seed 86 draws the source's 4 thin, 4 middle and 2 tall slabs in its own order). Each slab patch sits on the same material at the same place in its slab: the bottom 128 px of a tall slab, the slanted side of a tall slab at 0.22 to 0.6 of its height (mirrored, since the render's tall slabs lean the other way), the interior of a tall slab, a whole thin slab. search.py scored other spots up to 0.02 higher; they were not used.

limits: Bench mean 0.975, lowest 0.90 (thin slab pink). The stack is generated: slab patches are matched by place in the matching slab, not by pixel; the side patch is mirrored because the render's tall slabs lean the other way.
The thin slab's pink scores 0.90: the source's thin bottoms read peach, 208 156 169, a JPEG blend of the 4 px yellow and pink bands that the render keeps apart.
The ground spectrum scores 0.92: the source's ground carries a slow mottle the render's 4 px mottle does not fully reach without lifting the fine grain past the measured 0.57.
The measured palette keeps the source's light gray ground, 228 227 222; every alternate uses a neutral or cool ground.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
